title: NFL calls Brendan Sorsby's issues 'too significant,' declines 2026 supplemental draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL calls Brendan Sorsby's issues 'too significant,' declines 2026 supplemental draft
sources.description: The NFL will not hold a supplemental draft this summer, thereby denying the Texas Tech QB entry into the league for the 2026 season.
